title: The Beat Between
caption: What are beats in music? Two notes almost the same don't sound like two notes — they sound like one note wobbling, and it wobbles exactly as many times a second as they are apart. THE OBSERVER WORLD — Chapter II, Episode 9. The dark stops copying tones and takes the Elder's voice. It gets close. Six wobbles a second. Then three. Then one. But close is not the same, and it can never land. So the Keeper, with almost no light left and no way to fight, wins with his ears: he holds the Elder's true note against the impostor and listens for the place where the wobble stops. This is how every piano in the world is tuned. Then he gives away the last of his light to bring the Elder back — and it is not enough. the more you know, the more you observe.  #musictheory #eartraining #tuning #animation #theobserverworld
